hook.en: Independence was not won on a battlefield but around meeting tables — in Kuala Lumpur and in London. How did leaders of different races learn to work as one team?
hook.bm: Kemerdekaan tidak dimenangi di medan perang tetapi di meja rundingan — di Kuala Lumpur dan di London. Bagaimanakah pemimpin pelbagai kaum belajar bekerja sebagai satu pasukan?

bigIdeas.en: The British prepared local leaders for self-government through the Member System (1951).
bigIdeas.bm: British menyediakan pemimpin tempatan untuk pemerintahan sendiri melalui Sistem Ahli (1951).

bigIdeas.en: Cooperation between UMNO, MCA and MIC formed the Alliance (Perikatan), proving the races could work together.
bigIdeas.bm: Kerjasama UMNO, MCA dan MIC membentuk Parti Perikatan, membuktikan kaum-kaum boleh bekerjasama.

bigIdeas.en: The London talks (1956) and the Reid Commission prepared the way for independence on 31 August 1957.
bigIdeas.bm: Rundingan London (1956) dan Suruhanjaya Reid membuka jalan kepada kemerdekaan pada 31 Ogos 1957.

detail.en: UMNO–MCA pact wins Kuala Lumpur election
detail.bm: Pakatan UMNO–MCA menang pilihan raya Kuala Lumpur

definition.en: 1951 scheme in which local leaders were given ministerial-type portfolios.
definition.bm: Skim 1951 yang memberi pemimpin tempatan portfolio seperti menteri.

definition.en: Communities Liaison Committee (1949) — leaders of different races discussing common issues.
definition.bm: Jawatankuasa Hubungan Antara Kaum (1949) — pemimpin pelbagai kaum membincangkan isu bersama.

definition.en: Coalition of UMNO, MCA and MIC.
Signed 8 February 1956; Britain agreed to independence by 31 August 1957 if possible.
definition.bm: Ditandatangani 8 Februari 1956; Britain bersetuju memberi kemerdekaan pada 31 Ogos 1957 jika boleh.

definition.en: Independent commission led by Lord Reid that drafted the 1957 Constitution.
definition.bm: Suruhanjaya bebas diketuai Lord Reid yang merangka Perlembagaan 1957.

question.en: Why was inter-ethnic cooperation important for independence? (4 marks)
question.bm: Mengapakah kerjasama antara kaum penting untuk kemerdekaan? (4 markah)

steps.en: Point 1: the British set unity as a condition for independence.
steps.bm: Isi 1: British menetapkan perpaduan sebagai syarat kemerdekaan.

steps.en: Point 2: the Alliance's win in 1955 proved the races could govern together.
steps.bm: Isi 2: kemenangan Perikatan pada 1955 membuktikan kaum-kaum boleh memerintah bersama.

answer.en: Link each point to independence — that is what earns the elaboration mark.
answer.bm: Kaitkan setiap isi dengan kemerdekaan — itulah yang memberi markah huraian.

prompt.en: The Member System was introduced in…
prompt.bm: Sistem Ahli diperkenalkan pada…

explanation.en: Local leaders received portfolios such as health and education in 1951.
explanation.bm: Pemimpin tempatan menerima portfolio seperti kesihatan dan pendidikan pada 1951.

prompt.en: Which three parties formed the Alliance (Perikatan)?
prompt.bm: Tiga parti manakah yang membentuk Perikatan?

explanation.en: UMNO, MCA and MIC worked together as the Alliance.
explanation.bm: UMNO, MCA dan MIC bekerjasama sebagai Perikatan.

prompt.en: The Communities Liaison Committee was set up in the year ______.
prompt.bm: Jawatankuasa Hubungan Antara Kaum ditubuhkan pada tahun ______.

explanation.en: The CLC brought leaders of different races together in 1949.
explanation.bm: CLC menghimpunkan pemimpin pelbagai kaum pada 1949.

prompt.en: Who led the independence mission to London in 1956?
prompt.bm: Siapakah yang mengetuai rombongan kemerdekaan ke London pada 1956?

explanation.en: Tunku Abdul Rahman led the mission of the rulers' and Alliance representatives.
explanation.bm: Tunku Abdul Rahman mengetuai rombongan wakil raja-raja dan Perikatan.

prompt.en: The London Agreement was signed on…
prompt.bm: Perjanjian London ditandatangani pada…

explanation.en: Britain agreed to independence on 31 August 1957 if possible.
explanation.bm: Britain bersetuju memberi kemerdekaan pada 31 Ogos 1957 jika boleh.

prompt.en: The commission that drafted the 1957 Constitution was led by Lord ______.
prompt.bm: Suruhanjaya yang merangka Perlembagaan 1957 diketuai oleh Lord ______.

explanation.en: The Reid Commission was formed in 1956.

prompt.en: Who was the first president of the MCA?
prompt.bm: Siapakah presiden pertama MCA?

explanation.en: Tan Cheng Lock founded the MCA in 1949.
explanation.bm: Tan Cheng Lock mengasaskan MCA pada 1949.

prompt.en: In which election did the UMNO–MCA pact first win?
prompt.bm: Dalam pilihan raya manakah pakatan UMNO–MCA mula-mula menang?

explanation.en: They won 9 of 12 seats in Kuala Lumpur in 1952.
explanation.bm: Mereka memenangi 9 daripada 12 kerusi di Kuala Lumpur pada 1952.

prompt.en: Match each Reid Commission member with his country.
prompt.bm: Padankan ahli Suruhanjaya Reid dengan negaranya.

explanation.en: Sir Ivor Jennings from Britain was the fifth member.
explanation.bm: Sir Ivor Jennings dari Britain ialah ahli kelima.

prompt.en: Select ALL members of the 1956 London mission.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA anggota rombongan London 1956.

explanation.en: The mission had four rulers' representatives and four Alliance representatives, led by Tunku.
explanation.bm: Rombongan terdiri daripada empat wakil raja dan empat wakil Perikatan, diketuai Tunku.

prompt.en: What was the purpose of the Member System?
prompt.bm: Apakah tujuan Sistem Ahli?

explanation.en: It was a training ground for a future cabinet.
explanation.bm: Ia menjadi latihan untuk kabinet masa depan.

options.en: To train local leaders in running government departments
options.bm: Melatih pemimpin tempatan mengurus jabatan kerajaan

prompt.en: Arrange the steps of inter-ethnic cooperation in order.
prompt.bm: Susun langkah kerjasama antara kaum mengikut urutan.

items.bm: Pakatan UMNO–MCA dalam pilihan raya KL

prompt.en: How many memoranda did the Reid Commission receive?
prompt.bm: Berapakah memorandum yang diterima Suruhanjaya Reid?

explanation.en: It studied 131 memoranda, including one from the Alliance.
explanation.bm: Ia meneliti 131 memorandum, termasuk satu daripada Perikatan.

prompt.en: Why was the Reid Commission made up of members from Commonwealth countries, not Malaya?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah Suruhanjaya Reid dianggotai ahli dari negara Komanwel, bukan Tanah Melayu?

explanation.en: Outside experts were seen as fair to all groups.
explanation.bm: Pakar luar dianggap adil kepada semua pihak.

options.en: Because Malaya had no educated people
options.bm: Kerana Tanah Melayu tiada orang berpelajaran

prompt.en: Who led the MIC when it joined the Alliance in 1954–1955?
prompt.bm: Siapakah yang memimpin MIC semasa menyertai Perikatan pada 1954–1955?

explanation.en: V.T. Sambanthan led the MIC from 1955. (John Thivy founded the MIC in 1946.)
explanation.bm: V.T. Sambanthan memimpin MIC dari 1955. (John Thivy mengasaskan MIC pada 1946.)

prompt.en: Which leader left UMNO in 1951 to form the multiracial Independence of Malaya Party (IMP)?
prompt.bm: Pemimpin manakah yang keluar UMNO pada 1951 untuk menubuhkan Parti Kemerdekaan Malaya (IMP) berbilang kaum?

explanation.en: Onn wanted UMNO open to all races; when refused, he founded the IMP.
explanation.bm: Onn mahu UMNO dibuka kepada semua kaum; apabila ditolak, beliau menubuhkan IMP.

prompt.en: Why did the Alliance succeed while the multiracial IMP failed?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah Perikatan berjaya sedangkan IMP berbilang kaum gagal?

explanation.en: A coalition of ethnic parties suited the society of the time.
explanation.bm: Gabungan parti berasaskan kaum sesuai dengan masyarakat ketika itu.

options.en: Each Alliance party kept its own community's support while cooperating at the top
options.bm: Setiap parti Perikatan mengekalkan sokongan kaum masing-masing sambil bekerjasama di peringkat atas

options.en: The IMP had too many members

prompt.en: What was the MOST important factor that convinced Britain to grant independence?
prompt.bm: Apakah faktor PALING penting yang meyakinkan Britain memberi kemerdekaan?

explanation.en: Unity proved the country could govern itself peacefully.
explanation.bm: Perpaduan membuktikan negara mampu memerintah sendiri dengan aman.

options.en: Inter-ethnic unity shown by the Alliance's strong election win
options.bm: Perpaduan kaum yang ditunjukkan oleh kemenangan besar Perikatan

options.en: A war between Malaya and Britain
options.bm: Perang antara Tanah Melayu dan Britain

prompt.en: The "social contract" (kontrak sosial) during independence talks refers to…
prompt.bm: "Kontrak sosial" semasa rundingan kemerdekaan merujuk kepada…

explanation.en: Non-Malays received citizenship; Malay special position, Islam and Malay were enshrined.
explanation.bm: Bukan Melayu menerima kerakyatan; kedudukan istimewa Melayu, Islam dan bahasa Melayu dimaktubkan.

options.en: Give-and-take between races on citizenship, Malay special rights, language and religion
options.bm: Tolak ansur antara kaum tentang kerakyatan, hak istimewa Melayu, bahasa dan agama

prompt.en: What lesson does the path to independence give for solving national problems today?
prompt.bm: Apakah pengajaran perjalanan ke arah kemerdekaan untuk menyelesaikan masalah negara hari ini?

explanation.en: Malaysia gained independence peacefully through negotiation.
explanation.bm: Malaysia mencapai kemerdekaan secara aman melalui rundingan.

options.en: Discussion and compromise are better than conflict
options.bm: Perbincangan dan tolak ansur lebih baik daripada konflik

options.en: Only foreign powers can solve problems
options.bm: Hanya kuasa asing boleh menyelesaikan masalah
